name: Louisiana

default_limits.basis: La. R.S. 32:61(A): 55 on any highway unless a lower limit is posted; 70 interstate/controlled-access; 65 multi-lane divided highways with partial/no access control. trunk=65 assumes divided multi-lane.

fine.notes: No statewide schedule; parish/city courts set amounts. First offense max $175 (R.S. 32:57(A)), plus $5 LERN fee (R.S. 32:61(C)).

court_costs.notes: Varies by parish and court; no statewide figure found.

points.notes: No state point system (secondary source; no official OMV page read).

zones.work_zone: $500–$1,000 fine when workers are on site (R.S. 32:57(H)).
zones.school_zone: School-zone speeding cannot be paid by mail (R.S. 32:57(E)); no statewide fine increase found.

court.reason: 15+ over: no pay-by-mail and no written promise to appear in lieu of bond (R.S. 32:57(E)(2)).

trucks.notes: R.S. 32:61 sets no separate truck limits.

notes: Any speeding conviction is technically jailable up to 30 days (R.S. 32:57(A)). Reckless operation has no mph threshold. Unposted streets are legally 55, but cities usually post lower limits. One secondary site claims 75 on interstates; current statute says 70.
